entry_state: The company example connects maturity conversion or redemption to tax, group cash/equity, parent earnings and nonoverlapping share windows. A different initial fiscal base creates deferred tax 2 charged to equity and net conversion equity 6. That issue-date charge does not determine the later earnings tax effect; the following roll-forward begins to derive it for a separate instrument.
exit_state: The separate principal-100 instrument derives its tax reversal and financing cost 9 before joining company earnings and EPS. Apple's displayed share counts and weighted averages constrain timing without identifying dates: two constructed histories satisfy selected annual, first-quarter and purchase-window constraints. The following award discussion distinguishes RSUs, net common issuance, equity changes and cash, and its grant-value/future-cost explanation continues next.
findings: The compound schedule separates coupon deduction from discount accretion and reverses the initial DTL through earnings once, producing after-tax cost 9.
Equal diluted fractions arise because both cases restore the same earnings and use the same share dates; the text explicitly retains different actual earnings and principal obligations.
Apple EPS calculations convert millions of dollars and thousands of shares consistently. Annual and quarterly weighted averages are not summed as closing quantities.
The two authored share histories satisfy stated quantity constraints but differ at elapsed day 100; prices, awards and monetary journals remain unconstructed. No new confirmed defect.

equation.exposition_role: Mechanism-bearing average-share relation in the simplified 52-week history.
equation.symbols_units_domain: Sbar, S0 and DeltaS_j are ordinary shares; d_j are integer elapsed days with 0<=d_j<364.
equation.assumptions_timing: No splits or other quantity changes; net issuance is aggregated into one illustrative event and displayed centres are exact only for the witness.

equation.interpretation: Immediate changes receive full weight, final-day changes one day's weight; neither average nor close identifies every event.
